paragraphs: Week 9 (Nov 6 – 10, Lectures 17 and 18) Teaching and Learning
7.1 Inverse functions and their derivatives: one-to-one and onto properties (injectivity and surjectivity); definition of inverse functions; inverse differentiation (Theorem 1).
